messages:
Samir Patel: hey team — heads up that I need to ask for a short-term accommodation starting next week. my morning schedule will shift because of caregiving drop-off (need to be out 8:15–9:30am). can we do a 10:30am start for 6–8 weeks and swap my desk to a quieter area? there’s been repeated noise from the east bench and it’s making focused work impossible. not looking for full remote, just schedule and quieter seat for now.

Ravi Kumar: thanks for flagging, Samir. that sounds reasonable. can you confirm which days this applies to and whether there are any on-call or syncs between 9–10? i can cover standups if needed.

Samir Patel: it’s M/W/F mornings primarily. i can move async for the 9am sync on M and F, and i’ll be available via slack for urgent stuff. no on-call conflicts those weeks.

Ava - People Ops: Samir — we can start interim adjustments immediately. please send a quick note to people-ops@redwood.com so we can open an accommodation intake. we’ll keep this confidential and only involve your manager and facilities as needed. i can schedule a 20m intake call to document needs and discuss what reasonable adjustments look like. would you prefer morning or afternoon intake?

Samir Patel: afternoon is best. thanks. i don’t have a formal doc from a provider yet but can get one if needed later.

Jesse (HR Counsel): quick note — medical documentation can help but it isn’t always required to grant a reasonable accommodation. we’ll request only what's necessary and follow confidentiality rules. People Ops will advise on timelines.

Leah (Facilities): flagged — we have a few quieter desks on the north side and an empty team room we can offer temporarily. can Ava loop me in if Samir wants a seat swap? we can also test a white-noise machine at the bench.

Ava - People Ops: looping Leah. Samir, i set a provisional intake for Thu 3:30pm — calendly.com/ava-hr/20 — if that works reply here and i’ll finalize. interim 10:30am start approved by Ravi. Ravi, can you confirm backup for the 9am sync on M/F?

Ravi Kumar: confirmed — i’ll cover those syncs and mark it on the calendar. i’ll also let the team know about temporary shift coverage (no details about reason). :thumbsup:

PeopleOpsBot: new-accommodation-ticket #ACM-2024-198 created for Samir Patel by Ava - People Ops (status: intake scheduled).

Samir Patel: thanks everyone, really appreciate the quick help. keeping this confidential would mean a lot.

Ava - People Ops: absolutely. next steps: (1) Samir sends email to people-ops@redwood.com with brief request, (2) intake on Thu 3:30 to document functional limitations and proposed adjustments, (3) facilities will trial quieter seat, (4) manager will implement temporary coverage. we’ll update you in-thread with any logistics but not share medical details.

Jesse (HR Counsel): i’ll be available if any legal nuance pops up, but this sounds like straightforward accommodation.

Samir Patel: perfect. i’ll email now. thanks again. :pray:
